causal_model_selection_check.methodology: For each test year, choose the forecast-safe model with the best mean WMAPE on earlier test years only; first year defaults to ridge_lag_only.

methodology: Candidate sources are evaluated incrementally against ridge_lag_only. Lagged sources are forecast-safe T-1. SITADEL monthly Q1/H1 current-year features are nowcast variants, not pure forecast features.
